messages.author: a53ff18a8f5a4d68
messages.subject: Problem with DMR analysis in MethylKit
parts:
Dear all,

I have tried several times with my data but I could not solve the problem. I have extract just first 100k first row from Bismark Coverage file and I have tried the normal pipeline codes for analysis but I saw NA 

I have attached my RData in a zip file this link ==> https://ufile.io/svqbb Please help me to fix it :

After downloading  unzip the file with:

unzip 100k_files.zip



#---------------------------------------------
# ------And my R codes :

#---------------------------I faced with error from these below lines--------------

load(100k.RData)
library(methylKit)

meth <- unite(myobj, destrand=FALSE)
getCorrelation(meth,plot=TRUE)
clusterSamples(meth, dist="correlation", method="ward", plot=TRUE)


g1 <- c("l_rep1.cov","l_rep2.cov","l_rep3.cov")
g2 <- c("rl_rep1.cov","rl_rep2.cov")
g3 <- c("srm_rep1.cov" ,"srm_rep2.cov" , "srm_rep3.cov")
sample_group <- list(g1,g2,g3)
myobj2=reorganize(myobj,sample.ids=c(g1, g3),treatment= c(rep(1,length(g1)),rep(2,length(g3))) )
meth2 =reorganize(meth,sample.ids=c(g1, g3),treatment= c(rep(1,length(g1)),rep(2,length(g3))) )



tiles=tileMethylCounts(myobj2,win.size=1000,step.size=1000)
head(tiles[[1]],3)
myDiff2=calculateDiffMeth(meth2)

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------

parts:
Dear Dr. Akalin,

Thanks for prompt answer. I have used dput but it doesn't work for me. 

I have upload my RData in https://ufile.io/svqbb  it includes Coverage and Methylation plot which are not like manual ( my data belong to RRBS):

It would be great if you download RData from  https://ufile.io/svqbb  and try my code:

I have got error message in getCorrelation, clusterSamples , and calculateDiffMeth in below codes :

After unzipping try this :


#------------------------------------------My R code-----------------------------------------------------------------------
library(methylKit)
load("100k.RData")

meth <- unite(myobj, destrand=FALSE)
getCorrelation(meth,plot=TRUE)
clusterSamples(meth, dist="correlation", method="ward", plot=TRUE)


g1 <- c("l_rep1.cov","l_rep2.cov","l_rep3.cov")
g2 <- c("rl_rep1.cov","rl_rep2.cov")
g3 <- c("srm_rep1.cov" ,"srm_rep2.cov" , "srm_rep3.cov")
sample_group <- list(g1,g2,g3)
myobj2=reorganize(myobj,sample.ids=c(g1, g3),treatment= c(rep(1,length(g1)),rep(2,length(g3))) )
meth2 =reorganize(meth,sample.ids=c(g1, g3),treatment= c(rep(1,length(g1)),rep(2,length(g3))) )
tiles=tileMethylCounts(myobj2,win.size=1000,step.size=1000)
head(tiles[[1]],3)
myDiff2=calculateDiffMeth(meth2)

#-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------




Thanks for supports.

Ahmad

meth <- unite(myobj, destrand=FALSE)
